skill.name: set-up-magento-google-ads-poas-bidding
skill.description: Use Product Metrics to prepare Magento order profit as a Google Ads conversion value. Check tracking, estimate a starting target ROAS, and guide the account owner through switching from revenue to profit.
skill.summary: Prepare profit-based Google Ads bidding for Magento with Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most static matches describe Markdown formatting, documentation links, or ordinary account setup. Confirmed risks involve third-party software installation and access to order-level data. The instructions also lack safeguards for unrelated credentials, broader setup actions, and browser handoffs.

remediation.issue: The Magento setup adds an external package source, and the skill install command does not pin its dependencies.
remediation.suggestion: Require developer approval and document verified package integrity, pinned installer and source revisions, staging tests, and rollback steps.

remediation.issue: Order verification can list real orders when a single test order is sufficient.
remediation.suggestion: Require the approved workspace and a test order identifier. Retrieve only arrival status and profit readiness, and omit customer details from the response.

remediation.issue: Shared rules permit collecting secrets unrelated to Magento and Google Ads.
remediation.suggestion: Remove unrelated credential exceptions. Use Google authorization and private Magento configuration import without receiving secrets in chat or command arguments.

remediation.issue: Prerequisite setup can enable additional data exports or channels beyond the requested profit bidding.
remediation.suggestion: Explain the accounts, permissions, and data involved before setup. Require separate approval for the full conversion bundle and exclude unrelated channels by default.

remediation.issue: The assistant relays browser URLs returned by tools without verifying their destination.
remediation.suggestion: Verify HTTPS and the expected destination for the current step. When verification fails, direct the user to the known account portal.

content.user_title: Set Up Profit Bidding for Magento in Google Ads
content.value_statement: A campaign can meet its revenue target and still lose money after costs. Use Product Metrics to check tracking and prepare Google Ads to bid on Magento order profit.
actual_capabilities: Read setup status through the Product Metrics CLI or MCP server and identify unfinished steps.
Guide Magento and Google Ads connection, consent setup, and additional cost configuration.
Check whether a paid test order arrived and whether it has revenue and profit values.
Identify the profit and revenue conversion actions and verify their status after an account owner makes changes.
Suggest a starting target ROAS percentage from the campaign's current profit on ad spend when that metric is available.
limitations: A developer installs the Magento module, and an authorized user manages store and Google Ads settings.
The documented workflow requires Product Metrics Pro and linked Merchant Center and Google Ads client accounts.
Unknown costs can result in revenue-only reporting, and loss-making orders are sent with zero profit.
This workflow does not configure bidding for new customers, returning customers, or lifetime value.

use_cases.title: Check whether a store is ready
use_cases.description: Find out which connections, consent settings, and cost inputs are needed before using profit as the conversion value.

use_cases.title: Plan a campaign switch
use_cases.description: Compare revenue and profit conversion actions and propose a starting target for one campaign.

use_cases.title: Verify a test order
use_cases.description: Check whether a test order produced both conversion values and identify what to inspect if profit is missing.

prompt_templates.title: Explain profit bidding
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the difference between revenue and profit bidding for Magento. Tell me what I need before testing profit bidding in Google Ads.
prompt_templates.scenario: You are deciding whether profit is a better conversion value for your store.

prompt_templates.title: Review setup readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the setup status for my selected Magento store and Google Ads account. List what is ready and what I still need to do. Do not change settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a Product Metrics workspace and want to review prerequisites.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose missing profit
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my designated test order for revenue and profit. If profit is missing, explain which cost, currency, or consent settings to verify. Omit customer information.
prompt_templates.scenario: A paid test order arrived, but the profit conversion value is missing.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a one-campaign switch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the current POAS for my selected campaign to propose a starting target ROAS. List the manual goal changes and the checks to run afterward. Do not change campaign settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Profit tracking is active and you want to test bidding on profit in one campaign.

output_examples.input: My test order arrived with revenue only. What should I check?
output: Verify that additional costs are active and all order costs are known.
If the order currency differs from the store base currency, check the Merchant Center cost or configured fallback.

output_examples.input: My campaign has a POAS of 1.5. What target should I try?
output: Consider 150% as a starting target ROAS when Google Ads uses profit as the conversion value.
Test it on one campaign. Keep the old purchase action secondary for that campaign and review results after a few weeks.

best_practices: Confirm consent and cost settings, then validate the profit value with a paid test order before switching a campaign.
Use one primary purchase action per campaign and keep the previous purchase action as secondary.
Start with one campaign and use its recent POAS to estimate the initial target.
anti_patterns: Keep the same target percentage when switching from revenue to a smaller profit value.
Make revenue and profit primary purchase actions for the same campaign.
Paste a Magento private configuration file or an account credential into the assistant chat.

faq.question: Does Google Ads have a separate POAS bid setting?
faq.answer: This workflow uses Maximise conversion value with a target ROAS. Choosing the profit conversion action makes that target apply to profit instead of revenue.

faq.question: Do I need a developer to connect Magento?
faq.answer: Yes. A developer installs the Product Metrics module and makes sure Magento cron runs.

faq.question: Why can an order show revenue without profit?
faq.answer: At least one cost may be unknown. Check Magento item costs, Merchant Center costs, and the configured fallback.

faq.question: Will the assistant switch the primary conversion?
faq.answer: No. The account owner changes it in Google Ads. The assistant can check the action status afterward.

faq.question: Which consent is needed for the profit conversion?
faq.answer: The documented setup requires analytics and ad user data consent. The built-in Magento cookie notice does not grant that consent.

faq.question: What happens after a refund?
faq.answer: When Magento reports the refund, Product Metrics adjusts the Google Ads conversion.
